legal_units.title: Liability of person in respect of income included in income of another person.
legal_units.text: Where, income of a person, other than the assessee, arising from any asset, or income from membership of a firm, is included in the total income of the assessee under this Chapter or under section 25(a), then, irrespective of anything to the contrary contained in any other law in force,—
